title: Trump Floats Another "Epic Fury" Strike as Hormuz Shipping Reroutes
en: President Donald Trump said on October 23 that the United States might carry out another small-scale "Epic Fury" operation against Iran, or that Tehran could choose to compromise. "If they're smart, they'll say let's talk seriously," he told supporters in Florida. Hours earlier, Iran's Revolutionary Guard said two supertankers carrying more than 4.5 million barrels of crude struck mines south of the Strait of Hormuz and were abandoned by their crews. Shipping data from Kpler shows flows through the strait running at about 14 million barrels a day, roughly 82% of pre-war levels, while around 40% of non-Iranian crude now bypasses the waterway, up from 17% before the conflict.
zh: 美国总统特朗普10月23日表示，美国或许会再次对伊朗发动一次小规模的“史诗怒火”行动，也可能伊朗会选择妥协。他在佛罗里达州对支持者说：“如果他们够聪明，就会说咱们来谈正事吧。”数小时前，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队称，两艘共载有超过450万桶原油的超级油轮在霍尔木兹海峡以南触雷，船员弃船逃生。Kpler的航运数据显示，通过海峡的石油流量约为每日1400万桶，约为战前水平的82%；目前约40%的非伊朗原油选择绕开这条水道，而战前这一比例仅为17%。

title: France Deploys 70,000 Officers as Cost-of-Living Protests Turn Violent
en: Hundreds of thousands of people marched across France on October 24 in a second consecutive weekend of protests over the cost of living, inequality and the government's economic policies. The Interior Ministry counted around 410,000 participants, including about 110,000 in Paris, while the CGT union put the national figure closer to 800,000. Authorities deployed 70,000 police and gendarmes, 10,000 more than a week earlier, and shut the Louvre, the Musée d'Orsay and the Paris Opera as a precaution. After the main Paris rally dispersed, riot police used tear gas and water cannon against roughly 500 hooded youths. Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said nearly 1,000 people were arrested nationwide.
zh: 10月24日，数十万法国民众走上街头，这是连续第二个周末爆发抗议，诉求指向生活成本上涨、社会不平等以及政府的经济政策。法国内政部统计全国参加者约41万人，其中巴黎约11万人；法国总工会则估计全国接近80万人。当局当天部署7万名警察和宪兵，比一周前增加1万人，并出于防范关闭卢浮宫、奥赛博物馆和巴黎歌剧院。巴黎主会场游行队伍散去后，防暴警察对约500名蒙面青年使用了催泪瓦斯和高压水炮。内政部长努涅斯表示，全国近1000人被捕。
vocab: n. 参与人数，到场规模

title: Russia and Ukraine Confirm a Synchronised Ceasefire at Aleshky
en: Russia and Ukraine confirmed on October 24 that they will hold a synchronised ceasefire around Aleshky, a town in the Kherson region, to allow a humanitarian operation. Moscow's human rights commissioner said Russian forces would stop firing from 4 a.m. Moscow time on October 27; Ukraine's parliamentary commissioner said Kyiv would begin at 3 a.m. local time, matching the Russian schedule. President Volodymyr Zelensky said the deal should open corridors for food, medicine and the evacuation of civilians. The Kremlin separately confirmed that Russian, American and Ukrainian negotiators plan a new round of talks in Abu Dhabi in the first half of November, although Zelensky insists Ukraine will not give up more territory to end the war.
zh: 俄罗斯与乌克兰10月24日确认，将在赫尔松地区的小城阿列什基周边实施同步停火，以便开展人道主义行动。俄方人权事务专员表示，俄军将自莫斯科时间10月27日4时起停止开火；乌方议会人权事务专员称，基辅将于当地时间3时开始停火，与俄方时间一致。乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，该安排应能打通运送食品、药品和疏散平民的通道。克里姆林宫另外确认，俄、美、乌三方谈判代表计划于11月上半月在阿布扎比举行新一轮会谈，但泽连斯基强调，乌克兰不会为结束冲突放弃更多领土。
vocab: adj. 同步的，同时进行的

title: Gold Breaks Below $4,000 as Investors Reach for Cash
en: Investors sold risk assets again on October 23 as worries about artificial-intelligence spending collided with a jump in oil prices. Wall Street's main indexes closed lower, with the Dow down 1.23%. Spot gold fell 0.71% to $3,996.10 an ounce, its first close below $4,000 since July and a 4.07% loss for the week, as money managers sold bullion to raise cash rather than to express a view on inflation. The ten-year US Treasury yield rose 4.15 basis points to 4.9945%, while the two-year added 4.21 basis points to 4.6818%. The Federal Reserve meets on October 27 and 28, with futures pricing a better than 90% chance that policymakers leave rates unchanged.
zh: 10月23日，投资者再度抛售风险资产：对人工智能支出的担忧与油价跳涨叠加发酵。华尔街主要指数收跌，道指下跌1.23%。现货黄金跌0.71%至每盎司3996.10美元，为7月以来首次收于4000美元下方，全周累计下跌4.07%——基金经理卖出黄金是为了筹措现金，而非表达对通胀的看法。美国10年期国债收益率上行4.15个基点至4.9945%，2年期上行4.21个基点至4.6818%。美联储将于10月27日至28日召开议息会议，利率期货显示决策者维持利率不变的概率超过90%。

title: Britain Urges Households to Stock Three Days of Supplies
en: The British government has launched a "Be Ready" campaign urging households to keep enough supplies to get through three days if national services are disrupted. Published on October 22 alongside a statement by Security Minister Dan Jarvis, the guidance recommends three days of bottled water and non-perishable food, a torch with spare batteries, a wind-up radio, a first-aid kit, cash and copies of important documents. Officials cited severe weather, cyberattacks and supply-chain disruption, and said the aim is national resilience without panic buying. The advice landed as Storm Austen, with gusts close to 179 km/h, cut power to more than 16,000 homes in south-west England and nearly 300,000 in France.
zh: 英国政府已启动“做好准备”宣传活动，呼吁家庭储备足够物资，以便在国家公共服务中断时支撑三天。该指引于10月22日连同安全事务大臣丹·贾维斯的一份议会书面声明一同发布，建议储备三天的瓶装饮用水和耐储存食物，另配带备用电池的手电筒、手摇收音机、急救包、现金以及重要证件复印件。官方列举的理由包括极端天气、网络攻击和供应链中断，并表示目标是提升国家韧性，同时避免引发恐慌性抢购。指南发布之际，风暴“奥斯汀”带来接近每小时179公里的阵风，已导致英格兰西南部逾1.6万户家庭断电，法国近30万户断电。
vocab: adj. 不易腐烂的，耐储存的
n. 韧性，抗冲击恢复能力

title: Moonshot AI Unveils Kimi K3.1 Pro, a Three-Trillion-Parameter Model
en: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro on October 24, the first model in its K3.1 series and, at roughly three trillion parameters, the largest open-weight model in the world. It handles a context window of one million tokens and, the company says, matches or approaches the strongest closed-source systems on coding, agent and knowledge benchmarks while costing about one-fifth as much as GPT-6 Astra. Moonshot sharply increased its reinforcement-learning compute, and said full model weights will be published before November 4. The launch came during a busy week for Chinese AI, which also brought a national AI foundation platform for the car industry holding 112.7 EFLOPS of computing power, plus new evaluation standards for embodied robots.
zh: 月之暗面于10月24日发布Kimi K3.1 Pro，这是其K3.1系列的首个模型，参数规模约3万亿，为全球参数量最大的开放权重模型。它支持100万词元的上下文窗口。公司称，该模型在代码、智能体和知识类基准测试中达到或接近最强闭源模型的水平，而价格约为GPT-6 Astra的五分之一。月之暗面大幅增加了强化学习的算力投入，并表示完整模型权重将在11月4日前公布。此次发布正值中国AI密集落地的一周：同期还发布了纳管112.7 EFLOPS算力的国家级汽车行业AI基座，以及面向具身智能机器人的新评测标准。
